items.title: Flattening over the points of a given subset of the closed fibre is cut out by a closed subscheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a closed subscheme of a henselian local base over which flatness of the module along the fibre at all points of a given subset of the closed fibre is exactly tested, with finite presentation of that subscheme under finite presentation hypotheses and closed quasi-compactness of the subset (statement lines 6930-6946, tag 05PG-adjacent). The first part is an intersection of the pointwise flattening subschemes; the second reduces to the affine case over a finite affine cover of the subset and then applies a limit preserving argument to conclude finite presentation. The reduction and the limit preserving step are the substance, so the claim is H2.
